AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89290382463
Zoom Meeting ID: 892 9038 2463
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 892 9038 2463#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.

Recommendation:   Review and Approve Warrant Registers: 03092021-A, 03092021-B, 03092021-C, 03092021-D, 03092021-E, 03092021-F, 03052021-A.
Warrant Registers
3.
Consideration of Resolutions to Oppose State Legislation that Undermines Local Control Over Housing and Land Use Decisions and Proposed Correspondence
Recommendation: 1) Adopt resolutions opposing State housing legislation that usurps local control, specifically AB 115, SB 6 and SB 477; and 2) Authorize the Mayor, on behalf of the City Council, to send a letter to the Governor opposing a proposal to allocate $4 million in State funding to create a Housing Accountability Office.
Staff Report
4.
Adoption of Resolution R21-09 (1) Accepting PW-680-20, the FY 19/20 Miscellaneous Street Repairs Project; (2) Authorizing the City Clerk to File the Notice of Completion for this Project; and (3) Authorizing the City Support Services Director to Release the Retention and Make Final Accounting Entries for this Project.
Recommendation: adopt Resolution R21-09: (1) accepting PW-680-20 the FY 19/20 Miscellaneous Street Repairs Project as complete, (2) authorizing the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion, (3) authorizing the City Support Services Director to release the retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office records the Notice of Completion and make final accounting entries for this project.
Staff Report
5.
Notification of Palos Verdes Tennis Club Emergency Capital Expenditure Greater Than $20,000
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
6.
Adoption of Resolution No. R21-10 Revising the Date and Time of the Traffic Safety Committee, Finance Advisory Committee and Investment Policy Advisory Committee Meetings to be Effective March 1, 2021.
Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. R21-10 Revising the Date and Time of the Traffic Safety Committee, Finance Advisory Committee, and Investment Policy Advisory Committee Meetings to be Effective March 1, 2021.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING(S)
7.
PC-548-21; Application to Remove Two Italian Stone Pines and One Eucalyptus Located in the Parkway Adjacent to 2304 Paseo Del Mar and Waive Planting the Designated Street Tree
Recommendation: Approve removal of two Italian stone pines and one Eucalyptus according to the Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals, requiring stump removal, payment of $1500 to the Tree Bank, a Tree Removal Permit, and to provide for the planting of three single-trunk Kentia palms, the Designated Street Tree for Paseo Del Mar.
Staff Report
Correspondence
Late Correspondence
OLD BUSINESS
NEW BUSINESS
8.
Adoption of Proposed Resolution R21-11 Authorizing Submittal of Application(s) for all California Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery Grants for which the City of Palos Verdes Estates is Eligible
Recommendation: adopt a proposed resolution authorizing submittal of application(s) for all California Department of Resources, Recycling, and Recovery (CalRecycle) grants for which the City of Palos Verdes Estates is eligible.
Staff Report
9.
Update on the Replacement of the City's Aging Finance System
Recommendation: Receive an update on replacement of the City's aging Finance System and direct the City Manager as deemed appropriate.
Staff Report
10.
Update on the City's Long Range Financial Plan and Road Map for Incorporation of the Capital Projects Identified in the HR Green 2020-2029 Capital Improvement Plan and Pension Debt into the Plan
Recommendation: Receive an update on the City's Long Range Financial Plan, the schedule for incorporation of capital projects identified in the HR Green 2020-2029 Capital Improvement Plan and pension debt into the Plan, and direct the City Manager as deemed appropriate.
Staff Report
11.
Proposed Police Department Key Performance Indicators (KPI's)
Recommendation: : 1) Review the Police Department's proposed Key Performance Indicators (KPI's); and 2) Provide feedback and direction on reporting frequency and format.
Staff Report
12.
Adoption of Resolution R21-12 Implementing the Police Ad Hoc Committee Recommendations Concerning the Palos Verdes Estates Police Department Organizational Structure
Recommendation: Adopt Resolution 21-12, implementing the recommendations of the Police Ad Hoc Committee.
Staff Report
13.
Adoption of Resolution R21-13 (1) Approving the Plans and Specifications and Awarding a Construction Contract to Ace Fence Company for the PVE Guardrail Project, City Project No. PW-672-19, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5283(010) in the Aggregate Amount of $502,487.70 ($456,807.00 Base Contract Plus $45,680.70 in Contingency); and (2) Appropriating Grant Funds ($302,478), Measure M ($150,000) and Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation Account (RMRA) ($50,009.70) to Fund Said Contract
Recommendation: Adopt proposed Resolution R21-13: (1) awarding a construction contract to Ace Fence Company for the PVE Guardrail Project (Project), City Project No. PW-672-19, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5283(010) in the aggregate amount of $502,487.70 ($456,807.00 base contract plus $45,680.70 in contingency); (2) appropriating Highway Safety Improvements Program (HSIP) Grant ($302,478), Measure M ($150,000) and Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation Account (RMRA) ($50,009.70) funds for such contract; and (3) authorizing the City Support Services Director to make such accounting entries for this Project as he deems appropriate.
Staff Report
14.
Adoption of Resolution R21-14 (1) Approving a Contract for Construction Management, Resident Engineer, and Inspection Services for the PVE Guardrail Project, City Project No. PW-672-19, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5283(010); and (2) Appropriating Road Maintenance Rehabilitation Account (RMRA) Funds in the Amount of $89,620.30 for Such Contract
Recommendation: adopt proposed resolution R21-14 approving a contract for construction management, resident engineer, and inspection services to Ardurra for the PVE Guardrail Project (Project), City Project No. PW-672-19, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5283(010) in the aggregate amount of $89,620.30 ($81,473.00 plus $8,147.30 in contingency); and (2) appropriating Road Maintenance Rehabilitation Account (RMRA) Funds in the amount of $89,620.30 for such contract.
Staff Report
